title: Best Trimlight Alternatives for Roofline Lighting in 2026
body_markdown:
Trimlight built the permanent roofline lighting category into something homeowners actually search for by name, and the franchise model gets a crew on your roof fast almost anywhere in the country. The ceiling shows up in two places: pricing and installation are set by whichever local franchisee covers your zip code, and once you're outside a metro area, wait times and support quality swing depending on that franchisee's crew size. **The best Trimlight alternative in 2026 is CleanGutters Lighting if you live in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want the person who designed your system also on the ladder installing it; Gemstone Lights if you want a nationally available app-controlled system outside that footprint.**

This guide breaks down five real Trimlight alternatives for permanent roofline lighting in 2026, with honest pros and cons for each — including where CleanGutters Lighting falls short.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting is the strongest Trimlight alternative for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want owner-installed work.
- Trimlight's franchise model means install quality and response time depend on your local dealer, not one national standard.
- Gemstone Lights and HALO Lighting are the closest national app-controlled competitors outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area.
- Kichler Permanent Lighting fits homeowners already running Kichler landscape fixtures who want one ecosystem.
- DIY permanent lighting kits are the only real option if a professional install budget isn't on the table in 2026.


## Why this matters

Permanent roofline lighting is a multi-year install, not a seasonal decoration you swap out. Picking the wrong system or the wrong installer means living with a lighting track bolted to your fascia for the life of the house — or paying twice to redo it.

Trimlight popularized the category, and it remains a legitimate option in most of the country. But [permanent roofline lighting brands](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-permanent-roofline-lighting-brands) vary a lot in who actually shows up to install the system, how the control app works day to day, and whether the company has any skin in the game after the ladder comes down. That's the real decision in 2026, not the brand name on the box.

## Trimlight alternatives at a glance

| System | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from Trimlight |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Trimlight** | Homeowners anywhere in the US wanting brand recognition | National franchise network | Baseline for comparison |
| **CleanGutters Lighting** | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware homeowners | Owner installs every job personally | Independent local contractor, not a franchise |
| **Gemstone Lights** | Homeowners outside the tri-state footprint wanting app control | Wide dealer network with color-changing app control | Also franchise-model; competes with Trimlight nationally |
| **Kichler Permanent Lighting** | Homes already using Kichler landscape lighting | Fits an existing Kichler outdoor lighting ecosystem | Comes from an established fixture manufacturer, not a lighting-only franchise |
| **HALO Lighting** | Smart-home-focused households | Smart-home platform integration | Built around app ecosystems rather than a franchise install network |
| **DIY permanent kits** | Budget-first installers comfortable on a ladder | No install labor at all | No professional design or install service |

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners

[CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) installs custom architectural roofline lighting alongside micro-mesh gutter guard installation and gutter repair across South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. The company has been in business since 2009, and Alex installs every job personally — not subcontractors, which is the norm at franchise-model competitors including Trimlight.

That owner-installed model is the strongest argument for choosing CleanGutters Lighting over a franchise brand in 2026: the person who quoted the job is the person running track along your fascia.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**
- Same person designs and installs every job — no subcontractor handoff
- Local familiarity with tri-state roof styles, fascia conditions, and weather load
- Roofline lighting can be bundled with gutter guard installation or gutter repair on one visit

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**
- Service area is limited to South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware — no option outside it
- Independent contractor, so there's no national brand name behind the install
- One crew means scheduling depends on a single calendar, not a dealer network

**Best for:** Homeowners in the tri-state service area who want direct accountability from the installer.

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Trimlight |
|---|---|---|
| Who installs | Alex installs every job personally | Local franchisee's crew |
| Service footprint | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware | National franchise network |
| Business model | Independent local contractor since 2009 | Franchise brand with dealer standards |
| Bundled services | Gutter guards, gutter cleaning and repair | Lighting-focused |

**Verdict: Buy** — if you're inside the service area.

## 2. Gemstone Lights: best for national app-controlled color-changing systems

Gemstone Lights runs a franchise dealer network similar to Trimlight's, with app-controlled color-changing permanent lighting available across most of the country. It is the most direct national competitor to Trimlight in the category in 2026.

**Where Gemstone Lights shines:**
- Broad dealer availability across the US
- App-based color and scheduling control comparable to Trimlight

**Where Gemstone Lights falls short:**
- Same franchise tradeoff as Trimlight — install quality tracks your local dealer
- No single point of accountability from design through install

**Best for:** Homeowners outside the CleanGutters Lighting footprint who still want a dealer network plus app control.

| Dimension | Gemstone Lights | Trimlight |
|---|---|---|
| Model | Franchise dealer network | Franchise dealer network |
| App control | Color-changing, scheduled scenes | Color-changing, scheduled scenes |
| Coverage | Most US markets | Most US markets |

**Verdict: Buy** — the closest like-for-like swap.

## 3. Kichler Permanent Lighting: best for landscape lighting integration

Kichler is an established outdoor and landscape lighting manufacturer that has moved into permanent roofline lighting. If a home already runs Kichler path lights or deck fixtures, keeping the roofline in the same manufacturer's ecosystem simplifies control and parts sourcing.

**Where Kichler shines:**
- Long manufacturer track record in outdoor lighting hardware
- Fits cleanly alongside existing Kichler landscape installs

**Where Kichler falls short:**
- Fewer dedicated permanent-lighting installers than Trimlight or Gemstone Lights in most markets
- Less name recognition specifically in the permanent roofline category

**Best for:** Homeowners already invested in Kichler landscape lighting who want one brand across the property.

**Verdict: Hold** — strong fixtures, thinner installer coverage.

## 4. HALO Lighting: best for smart-home integration

HALO Lighting positions its permanent systems around smart-home platform compatibility, which matters when the rest of the house already runs on one connected ecosystem. Compare feature sets in the [permanent lighting systems ranked by app control features](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/permanent-lighting-systems-ranked-by-app-control-features) breakdown before shortlisting.

**Where HALO shines:**
- App and smart-home tie-ins are the design focus, not an afterthought
- Useful when lighting scenes need to sync with other connected devices

**Where HALO falls short:**
- Installer availability is less consistent market to market than Trimlight's franchise footprint
- Smart-home depth is wasted if you only want holiday and accent lighting

**Best for:** Connected households that want roofline lighting on the same app as everything else.

**Verdict: Hold** — check local installer coverage first.

## 5. DIY permanent lighting kits: best for budget-first installers

DIY kits skip professional installation entirely — you buy track and fixtures and mount them yourself. It's the only option here with no install labor involved.

**Where DIY kits shine:**
- Material cost only, no installer labor
- Full control over timeline, with no crew schedule to work around

**Where DIY kits fall short:**
- No professional pass on wire routing, transformer placement, or fascia condition
- Coverage is limited to the manufacturer's product warranty — nobody stands behind the workmanship
- Track mounted into aging fascia can pull loose; see the guidance on [gutter guards for older homes with sagging fascia](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-gutter-guards-for-older-homes-with-sagging-fascia) for why fascia condition matters before anything gets screwed into it

**Best for:** Homeowners comfortable on a ladder who are testing the category before committing.

**Verdict: Skip** — unless your fascia is sound and you've done exterior electrical work before.

## Why people switch from Trimlight

- **Franchise variability.** Install quality and response time depend on whichever franchisee covers your address, and that varies dealer to dealer.
- **Coverage gaps.** Not every zip code has an active franchisee, which pushes homeowners toward local installers like CleanGutters Lighting or national alternatives like Gemstone Lights.
- **Wanting one point of contact.** Some homeowners want the designer and the installer to be the same person — a franchise model with subcontracted crews doesn't guarantee that.
- **Bundling.** A homeowner already replacing gutters or adding guards often prefers one contractor handling fascia-line work end to end rather than two trades on the same roofline.

## When staying with Trimlight is the right call

If you live outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware and you want a brand with national recognition plus a large dealer network, Trimlight is a reasonable pick in 2026. The franchise model is a tradeoff, not a defect — it buys availability in far more markets than any independent local installer can cover, and a strong local franchisee delivers work every bit as good as an owner-operator.

## FAQ


**What is the best Trimlight alternative in 2026?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the best Trimlight alternative for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners because the same person designs and installs every job. Outside that region, Gemstone Lights is the closest national app-controlled competitor.

**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Trimlight?**

Inside its tri-state service area, yes, if owner-installed work matters to you — Alex installs every job personally instead of a subcontracted crew. Outside that area, Trimlight wins on availability.

**Does permanent roofline lighting need a professional installer?**

It isn't strictly required, but a professional install covers wire routing, transformer placement, and fascia condition that DIY kits leave entirely to the homeowner. Track mounted into aging fascia is the most common failure point.

**Are Gemstone Lights and Trimlight the same kind of system?**

Both run a franchise dealer model with app-controlled color-changing roofline lighting, which makes them the two most direct national competitors in 2026. The practical difference is which dealer covers your address.

**Can permanent lighting be installed with gutter guards at the same time?**

Yes. CleanGutters Lighting installs roofline lighting alongside micro-mesh gutter guard installation and gutter repair in the same service area, which keeps fascia-line work with one contractor.

**Is DIY permanent lighting worth it compared to a professional install?**

DIY kits save install labor but skip the design pass on wire routing and fascia condition. They make sense for testing the category, not for a system you expect to run for years.

**Does Kichler make permanent roofline lighting?**

Kichler, a long-established outdoor lighting manufacturer, has expanded into permanent roofline lighting. It fits best on homes already running Kichler landscape fixtures.

**How long does permanent roofline lighting last?**

Lifespan depends far more on mounting and fascia condition than on the LEDs themselves. A track fastened into sound fascia by a professional outlasts one screwed into rotted board by years.


## One last thing

The detail most homeowners skip when comparing Trimlight alternatives in 2026 is the fascia board itself. Every permanent lighting system on this list fastens into it, and a soft or sagging fascia will fail long before any LED does — which is why an installer who also works on gutters and fascia every week spots the problem before mounting anything.
